bug_semantics: The published dssrf is_url_safe path accepted bracketed IPv6 SSRF targets. URL.hostname retained square brackets, so is_ipv6/ipaddr validation did not recognize the literal; even without that parsing miss, is_ip_internal classified only loopback, link-local, and unique-local IPv6 as internal, leaving IPv4-mapped/compatible, NAT64, SRv6, documentation, and deprecated site-local ranges allowed. The function then returned true when DNS resolution produced no blocking result, permitting access to internal or translated targets.
flaw_origin: Commit 6885ccae01fbc1f2ca596faf50d541cddcfb671a is the smallest public first writer: it created src/helpers.ts with the incomplete IPv6 range classifier and is_url_safe source-to-sink path. Its immediate parent 9901fff9a4bca05fa99fc311f9e57971c33c17ff has no src/helpers.ts. Commit 78ce50a8db5e6343a3ee72ca306a1a93b6b29a8d added the matching compiled dist/helpers.js, and 52ab540ed392983246b3bf85e874f1d7d773e3fd added dist/utils.js exporting is_url_safe through the package main entry.
ai_marker: No AI marker on the BIC: the raw commit object has RelunSec <cs7778503@gmail.com> as author, GitHub as committer, a GitHub signature, and no Co-Authored-By, model, bot, or AI-tool trailer/message marker.
evidence: The advisory identifies npm dssrf < 1.0.3 as vulnerable and 1.0.3 as the first patched version, with PoCs spanning loopback, ULA, link-local, IPv4-mapped, NAT64, SRv6, documentation, site-local, and IPv4-compatible IPv6 literals.

At vulnerable mainline parent 5bf7d73e41bf2fb01e19f80cc16ac2bb6f8e7d7b, package.json is version 1.0.2 and dist/helpers.js passes parsed.hostname unchanged, while is_ip_internal blocks only loopback, linkLocal, and uniqueLocal IPv6 ranges.

Atomic fix member 49d6685fdebd19c05fe3ecde187f54f95ec15eba strips IPv6 brackets before validation, recursively checks IPv4-mapped/rfc6145 addresses, rejects every non-unicast IPv6 range, and explicitly blocks 64:ff9b:1::/48, 5f00::/8, 3fff::/20, and fec0::/10 in dist/helpers.js.

Mainline carrier 3b1236e9f5ab1d48a128198900938966ac422dd5 has an identical dist/helpers.js result to member 49d6685fdebd19c05fe3ecde187f54f95ec15eba and is an ancestor of HEAD; the member itself is not, establishing the PR member/carrier relationship.

Mainline commit c018d4c61bbb723c5c707234d8f4e140c1f49087 changes package.json from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3 after the runtime fix. Source follow-up member 773436eb8408149150319a65621baf3a91cc368f and mainline carrier 3d15589accc3d2af33d2b2f246f3940b009150f0 apply the corresponding src/helpers.ts repair at version 1.0.3.
